stage1.impression: A tidy, competent interior render of a red acrylic speaker beside a record wall and a big backlit screen. It reads as CG, not a photograph: the light is even and fills everything, with no pools and no deep shadow, the concrete and the record spines look too clean and repeat, and the leather chair has a smooth plastic sheen. The speaker is the only colour, but it is darker than the record wall and screen behind it, so it isn't the clear hero.

blocking_9: Frame lum_median within 22-50 (now 57.3) with real pools of light and dark between them, not an even 50-65 wash on every wall
Speaker region lum_median >= 45 and brighter than the record wall and the screen, so it reads as the hero at a glance
The screen reads as a backlit frosted acrylic panel set in a reveal, at a level below the speaker, not a bright grey print
Concrete shows formwork board grain, pour lines and staining at 1:1; record spines vary in height and lean and are not one repeated set
Leather chair reads as aged leather (creases, low sheen, dark brown), not glossy red-brown plastic

Fir beams overhead and the speaker's base on the floor in frame, so the room reads as the brief's listening room; signs of life (a record out of its sleeve, a poured glass, a lit candle that actually lights the table)

defects.what: Overall too bright and flat for a night room: lum_median 57.3, p1 10.7, nothing below about 11; no deep shadow anywhere
Concrete wall evenly lit floor to ceiling (profile 49-63), lum_range 47.8; smooth surface, few tie holes, no board grain or staining at scale
Record wall lum_median 66, brighter than the speaker (38-41); brightest at the top (76), no pools from the spots; spines uniform and repeated, all dead vertical, smeared at 1:1
Screen is the largest bright area (median 83) and pulls the eye from the speaker; reads as a flat grey-white print with a thin frame, not a thick frosted panel in a reveal
Speaker cabinet median 41.5, under the 45 floor; the red glow is flat and even like a lit sign, and the internal batts read as pink plastic
Horn: a smeared, plastic-looking specular streak at the lower left of the bell
Leather chair: smooth, saturated red-brown sheen, no creasing or wear; reads as plastic
Side table and candle cut off at the bottom edge; the votive flame lights nothing around it
Speaker base and plinth cropped by the bottom of the frame
No ceiling or fir beams in frame although the card promises beams overhead; the top edge is plain wall and shelf
Credenza fronts are smooth and even, CG-clean veneer with no wear

changes.problem: The frame is too bright for a night interior and has no deep tones.
changes.expected: Frame median about 40; shadows under the chair and shelves fall to the low teens, so the lamps and speaker read as the light sources

changes.problem: The speaker is darker than the room around it, so it is not the hero.

evidence.measured: lum_median 41.5 against the record wall at 66 and the screen at 83

change.setting: lamps on each Ember speaker (4 x area, 2900 K)

changes.expected: With c1 applied, the cabinet still has median >= 48, light comes through the acrylic with a gradient from the lamps, and the polished edges glow brighter than the faces

changes.problem: The screen is the brightest large area and draws the eye from the speaker; it reads as a print, not a glowing panel.

evidence.measured: lum_median 83.1, p95 96.7, flat (lum_range 78 driven only by the image)

changes.expected: With c1, the screen median is about 35-45, below the speaker; it glows softly behind the chair instead of lighting the corner

changes.problem: The record wall is lit evenly and brightest at the top, with no pools of light; it outshines the speaker.

change.setting: record-wall strip emission; the record wall 3 x spot

changes.expected: Three distinct pools of light on the spines, with dark bays between them; region median under the speaker's

changes.problem: The board-formed concrete reads as a smooth, evenly lit CG surface.

evidence.measured: lum_range 47.8, y profile 49-63 (flat); at 1:1 no board grain or pour lines

change.setting: concrete tone and sheen; sconce (1 x point, 2400 K)
change.from: uniform tone, low variation; sconce 15.0 W
change.to: board-grain bump at 150 mm board pitch with pour lines every 600 mm, about 15% tonal staining, roughness 0.85; sconce 25.0 W so it grazes the wall and falls off toward the floor

changes.expected: Wall shows grazing texture with a bright pool near the sconce falling to darkness at the floor

changes.problem: The leather chair reads as glossy, saturated red-brown plastic and competes with the speaker's colour.

evidence.measured: r/g/b median 28/13/5 (saturated), smooth specular sheen with no creasing at 1:1

change.to: dark aniline brown about #2b2119, roughness 0.6, crease and wear normal map, slight lighter wear on the arm edges

changes.expected: The chair reads as worn leather in shadow; the only saturated red left is the speaker

changes.problem: The room shows no life and no atmosphere; the candle lights nothing.

evidence.measured: votive on the side table with no visible pool of light; haze 0.01 gives no air

change.setting: haze density; candles 9 x point; props
change.from: haze 0.01; candles 1.5 W; empty side table
change.to: haze 0.025; candles 3.0 W; add a record out of its sleeve leaning on the chair, a poured rocks glass on the side table, a few records pulled half out of the shelves and leaning

changes.expected: A warm pool on the side table, faint air in the speaker's light, the room looks in use; the record wall's rhythm is broken

changes.problem: The framing crops the speaker's base and the side table and shows no ceiling, so the fir beams from the brief are missing and the speaker looks cut off.

evidence.measured: speaker plinth and table cut at the bottom edge; no beams in the top 30 px

change.to: 35 mm, pulled back about 0.8 m along the same line to [14.1, 1.8, 1.15], target raised to z 1.35, verticals kept true (shift, not tilt) so the beams and the speaker's floor contact are both in frame

changes.expected: The whole speaker stands on the floor with room below it, fir beams visible across the top, and the lens looks less wide

out_of_scope.request: Make the speaker's internal batts and cabinet tint read less pink and flat
out_of_scope.why: The speaker's colour and parts (Ember tint, white batts) are fixed; only its lighting (c2) may change

out_of_scope.request: Thicken and set the screen's frosted panel into a deep reveal, so it reads as 30 mm acrylic and not a framed print
out_of_scope.why: The screens and their mounting are part of the room's design as fixed; only their brightness and the acrylic's roughness may change

out_of_scope.request: Replace the record-spine set with more varied assets (different heights, lean, worn sleeves)
out_of_scope.why: Partly asset work beyond the card's settings; listed under blocking_9 and nudged by props in c7
